C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 216
Date 1/4/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

March 31st 191 6

Sir,
It is reported that one of the Arsenal staff officers
named Zau 曹 has been detained on suspicion of giving
information to the rebels.
It is said that the Ningpo merchants in Shanghai are
very angry because Taoyin Chou 周 has sent a telegram to
Peking in their name saying that all the Ningpo people
in Shanghai wish Yuan Shih Kai to remain president.
It is reported that the Shanghai rebels have
sent twelve officers to Soochow.
An attack being expected on the Arsenal last
night, special precautions were taken.
It is reported that a military officer named
Yang 楊 has arrived at the Arsenal with several gifts
from the President to the Shanghai Military Governor.
Two young men, who are thought to be rebels, were
arrested in the vicinity of the Arsenal yesterday with
maps in their possession.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on I.S. Record 31.

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
第 216 号
日期 1916 年 4 月 1 日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916 年 3 月 31 日

先生：

据报，兵工厂一名姓曹（Zau）的职员因涉嫌向叛军提供情报而被拘留。

据悉，在沪宁波商人对道台周氏（Taoyin Chou）以他们的名义向北京发送电报一事极为愤怒，该电报称在沪所有宁波人希望袁世凯留任总统。

据报，上海叛军已派遣十二名军官前往苏州。

鉴于预计昨晚兵工厂将遭受攻击，已采取特别预防措施。

据报，一名姓杨（Yang）的军官已抵达兵工厂，携有总统赠予上海镇守使的数件礼物。

昨日，两名被认为是叛军的年轻男子在兵工厂附近被捕，身上搜出地图。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。

录入于工部局档案 31。
